mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_stock_movement (material_code, material_name, in_qty, out_qty, note, created_at) VALUES (#{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{inQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{outQty,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{note}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT pouch_net_weight_kg AS "pouchNetWeightKg", pouch_length_m AS "pouchLengthM", pouch_per_unit AS "pouchPerUnit", film_material_code AS "filmMaterialCode", pouch_material_code AS "pouchMaterialCode", box_material_code AS "boxMaterialCode" FROM products WHERE code = #{code}
